To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
adolescents use social networking sites to obtain relational information and to express their romantic interest.

adolescents perceive social networking sites as a valuable resource to gain information about a potential partner, that adolescents use the sites to express their romantic interest and that adolescents recognize the potential for jealousy and controlling behaviors on social networking sites.
adolescents perceive social networking sites as an important tool for information seeking, expressing interest, jealousy and break-ups in romantic relationships.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of social media within romantic relationships and dating among adolescents.

the way adolescents perceive the ways that romantic relationships are experienced through social networking sites, with a focus on the role of social network site profiles in the formation and dissolution of relationships.
the role of social media in romantic relationships.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the social networking sites play a role in romantic relationships and dating, and that the role of social network sites in adolescent dating relationships is not only limited to the use of the sites as a means for communication.
the adolescents in our sample perceive social networking sites as an important part and extension of their romantic relationships.
the use of social network sites in adolescent dating relationships has a positive impact on the development and maintenance of relationships.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of social networking sites in romantic relationships is not a one-size-fits-all approach.
social networking sites have become a central part of adolescent romantic relationships, and that they are used to both express and seek information on romantic relationships.
the use of social networking sites is a very important part of adolescent romantic relationships.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social networking sites are an important tool in the relational information seeking of adolescents.
social networking sites are an important source for relational information.
social media play an important role for adolescents in the romantic realm.
